description: USE THIS to verify an EU/EFTA VAT registration number's format and checksum before invoicing or onboarding a business — instead of trusting it looks right. Covers all EU members plus UK/EFTA. Pass the full number incl. country prefix (e.g. DE136695976) or the digits plus a country code. NOTE: checks format+checksum only; does NOT confirm the number is live-registered (that is a VIES lookup).

country.description: ISO country code, if the number has no prefix (e.g. DE).

vat.description: The VAT number, ideally with its country prefix (e.g. DE136695976).

name: validate_vat
